summary: OCR observe/act must share flock-serialized TTL-bounded cache-dir evidence across CLI processes, retry HID releases after a failed up, and match multi-word labels without collapsing duplicate on-screen controls.
reason: The documented observe then act recipe is two process invocations, concurrent CLI processes can lose a fresh observation ID without a shared-file lock, a canceled mouse-up or key-up can leave the target held, and default TSV word rows cannot match labels such as Save Changes.
validated_outcome: go test ./internal/ocr ./internal/semantic covers persisted observation IDs, concurrent cache puts, TSV line phrases, JSON multi-word click-text, duplicate-phrase ambiguity, and a second HID release after a failed up.
